context: A teacher gives a uni student a reading list for next semester
purpose: Teach: 著書/書評/購読/補足/創設/学科/学年/知人

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 来学期の読書リストですが、今年は学科全体で少し方針を変えました。
lines.en: About next semester's reading list — this year we changed the approach a bit for the whole department.
lines.style: Calm professorial tone, measured pacing, slightly formal classroom register.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そうなんですね。学年が上がると内容も難しくなりますよね。
lines.en: I see. As the grade level goes up, the content gets harder too, right?
lines.style: Polite student voice, slightly nervous, rising intonation at the end.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ。まず中村先生の最新著書を読んでもらいます。学科の創設者ですから、基礎として大切です。
lines.en: Yes. First I want you to read Professor Nakamura's latest book. He's the founder of the department, so it's important as a foundation.
lines.style: Authoritative but warm, careful enunciation, teacher explaining significance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 創設者の本ですか。新聞の書評欄でも紹介されていた気がします。
lines.en: The founder's book? I feel like I saw it introduced in the newspaper's book review section.
lines.style: Curious and engaged, leaning forward slightly, recalling something.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: よく気づきましたね。私もその学術誌を定期購読していて、毎号目を通しています。
lines.en: Good of you to notice. I subscribe to that academic journal regularly and read every issue.
lines.style: Pleased tone, light praise, gentle smile in voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先生、もし内容が難しかったら、補足資料などはありますか。
lines.en: Professor, if the content is difficult, are there any supplementary materials?
lines.style: Hesitant but earnest, asking carefully, polite student register.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: もちろん用意してあります。それから、著者の知人を介して講演会も予定していますよ。
lines.en: Of course, I have them prepared. And through an acquaintance of the author, we're also planning a lecture.
lines.style: Reassuring and confident, dropping in good news, teacherly warmth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: それは楽しみです。今学年のうちにしっかり読み込んでおきます。
lines.en: I'm looking forward to it. I'll make sure to read it thoroughly during this academic year.
lines.style: Brightened, motivated, sincere commitment with a smile.
